title: Local transcription engine: whisper.cpp base.en on the laptop, 5-second slices with a queue, model download on first use, model update setting
summary: Grillo can now transcribe speech on the laptop with whisper.cpp base.en through @fugood/whisper.node: model downloaded on first use and checked by size and SHA-256, 5-second slices through a queue, and a speechModelUpdates setting (automatic, ask, never; default ask).
friction: The first Mac CI run went red because two test files importing electron raced its first-use binary download on a fresh runner

deferred.what: The electron package downloads its binary the first time a test imports it; two test files importing it in parallel on a fresh CI runner race that download and corrupt Electron, so any story adding a second Electron test file turns CI red
deferred.why: Needs a CI pre-download step or a single Electron test file, outside this issue

deferred.what: On Windows npm installs the binding's CUDA (about 120 MB), Vulkan (about 40 MB) and WASM variants, which the app never loads; electron-builder ships them, growing the installer by about 170 MB
deferred.why: The packaging config belongs to the signing story and npm run dist is outside the gate
deferred.owner: issue #85 (signing configuration in the release workflow)

deferred.what: On a busy machine a 4-second slice took 3.2 to 4.2 seconds against the PRD's 1 to 2 second assumption (PRD section 13); if slices take longer than they last, the queue grows during a meeting
deferred.why: Thread count did not help; audio-context tuning is outside this issue
